headline: Sensex drops over 300 points as rising crude oil prices and inflation concerns weigh on Indian markets

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Inflation concerns continue to weigh on investor sentiment across Indian benchmark indices.
A rise in crude oil prices acted as a key trigger for the broader market decline.
Selling pressure in major stocks like HDFC Bank and Titan Company dragged indices down.
Weak international macroeconomic cues added to cautious trading in domestic markets.
whatHappening: Sensex fell over 300 points while Nifty dipped below the 25,200 level in intraday trading.
Delhi Airport issued an advisory alerting passengers that SpiceJet flights may be impacted.
Tata Consumer Products increased Tur Dal prices by Rs 20 per kg to Rs 135.
India VIX slipped even as Sensex and Nifty experienced a weak opening.
summary: Indian benchmark indices opened lower today with the Sensex dropping over 300 points and Nifty slipping below 25,200. Rising crude oil prices and ongoing inflation fears were key drivers behind the decline. Heavyweights HDFC Bank and Titan Company were among the top losers in the session.
